query: How do I download a capital-gains statement?
answer_text:
To download a capital-gains statement, go to your profile, select 'Reports', and under 'Tax' choose 'Mutual Fund - Capital Gains'. Select the desired financial year and click 'Download'.

Source: https://groww.in/help/mutual-funds/mf-others/how-to-download-capital-gain-report--50
